text:
maria_cs: Heads up — AcmeCorp reporting users reappear 10-15m after SCIM deprovision. They DELETE the user, we return 200, then the user shows up again with role 'admin'. Any immediate ideas?

samir_eng: Can you paste the SCIM logs or the payloads? Do we see an explicit POST/PUT after the DELETE, or is it a group push causing the reprovision? @lina_prod fyi.

maria_cs: From the customer: 'DELETE /Users/12345 200 OK' then ~10m later a 'POST /Users' with 201. Their connector logs show a group push shortly before the POST. They also mentioned a duplicate service-principal appearing in our UI.

scim-bot: Event: scim.user.delete user=12345 status=200 source=hosted timestamp=3079998900

lina_prod: Hypothesis: Okta (or their IdP) is doing a delayed reprovision via group push. If group.externalId differs (whitespace/normalization) we can create a new Group object that has the role mapping, which then reattaches roles to the user when Okta pushes membership. Check externalId normalization and whether we treat empty/whitespace externalIds as unique.

samir_eng: Also check whether the group->role mapper looks up groups by displayName or externalId. I remember a case where Okta sends members[].value as a different id namespace and we ended up creating a new user record. Share the mapping config and sample group payload.

maria_cs: Customer provided group push payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:Group"],
  "displayName": "acme-admins",
  "externalId": "ACME:group:123 ",
  "members": [{"value":"user-12345","display":"john.doe@acme.com"}]
}
```

ops_bot: Note: trailing space in externalId detected. Our normalizer in prod v2.1 trims externalId on read, but older deployments treat raw externalId as canonical. Trailing whitespace will create a separate group record.

samir_eng: If Okta sends "ACME:group:123 " (with trailing space) and we already have "ACME:group:123" (no space) we will create a new group object. Role mappings are attached to the group object with the space (or without) depending on which got mapped first. Repro path: 1) Customer deletes user via SCIM API 2) Okta pushes group with trailing-space externalId -> new group record created with role mapping -> Okta push of membership creates user again or reattaches role.

lina_prod: Quick mitigation for customer: (a) add a transform rule on Okta group push to trim externalId, or (b) change our connector config to prefer trimmed externalId when matching. Long term: update normalizer to canonicalize externalId (trim + lowercase) and log when incoming externalId differs after normalization.

maria_cs: They asked if our Dedicated/private deployment has any async reconciliation that might reassign roles after delete. I see role_assigner restarted at 3079998922 in the logs — could that have replayed mappings?

samir_eng: role_assigner logs show: 'group mapping resolved for externalId="ACME:group:123" targetRole=admin' at 3079998925 — that happened after the DELETE entry. Confirms recreation via group mapping path.

lina_prod: I'll file ENG-7089 to: (1) canonicalize externalId matching (trim + normalize), (2) add a warning event when normalized != incoming, and (3) backfill a one-off script to detect duplicate groups caused by whitespace. I'll also coordinate a short-lived mitigation to prevent automatic reattachment of roles when a group.id mismatch looks suspicious.

maria_cs: Customer applied a transform to trim externalId on their end and reported no reappear after 20m. They're good with the workaround for now. I'll follow up once ENG-7089 has a PR. Thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
